decision.observation: At 9:50 p.m., the farmer is on the fenced east-west road east of the farm, near its left edge; the road continues clearly to the right.
decision.hypothesis: Continuing east along this road should cross the bus stop area and reach the paved approach to Pelican Town.
decision.memory: Willy promised an item at the southeast beach. The clear mailbox-level farm path leads east to this road. In Pelican Town, seek a southern route rather than continuing straight to the eastern riverbank. Passing out costs money.
